_about: Language-specific matching for rename_to_ascii.py. Fill this in from the
audit report: its group tree gives you the sector names, and its filename
list gives you the layer-type keywords.
Nothing here is Arabic-specific - the same shape works for any language.
The values below are the Idlib FTTH project, kept as a worked example.
_sectors_note: Group name (as it appears in the layer tree) -> ASCII slug. Matching is substring, so a partial name is fine.
_layer_types_note: FIRST MATCH WINS - order most-specific first. 'عدد الكبلات' (cable count) must come before 'الكبلات' (cables) or every count layer is classified as a cable layer.
_standalone_note: Layers that belong to no sector/block. Exact source basename (no extension) -> the ASCII id to give it.
_block_regex_note: Extracts the block number from the block group's name.
_pattern_note: How an ASCII id is composed. {sector} {block} {type} are available; {block:02d} zero-pads so ids sort correctly as text.
_kmz_note: Reference containers get renamed too, and their sublayers need stable ids. id_stem is the prefix; geometry suffix (_pt/_ln/_pg) is appended automatically.
_kmz_sublayers_note: Sublayer name fragment -> extra id suffix, when one container holds several themes.
